description: This PHP source file defines the SaveEmployeeController class, which handles the employee save functionality in the OrangeHRM system. It sets up components and properties related to employee data, including employee ID, allowed image types, and password requirement status.

classes.name: SaveEmployeeController
classes.description: Controller responsible for saving employee data, initializing components with employee ID, image types, and authentication requirements.

methods.name: getIdGeneratorService
methods.description: Returns the IDGeneratorService instance, creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component with employee data before rendering, including generating employee ID and setting properties related to image types and password requirements.
